item.title: Iran live updates: Mojtaba Khamenei chosen as Iran's next supreme leader
item.summary: President Donald Trump called upon the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, military and police to "lay down their arms" against the U.S. and Israel.

item.summary: Oil prices continue to soar, rattling stock markets and threatening price increases for some essential products as war escalated in the Middle East.

item.summary: Israel has been launching dozens of strikes across the country including in the Hezbollah stronghold in the city.

item.title: WATCH: Iowa high school basketball player scores 8 points in 19 seconds
item.summary: Trailing in the final minute, Iowa high school sophomore Ava Smid delivered a stunning comeback -- scoring 8 points in just 19 seconds to win the girls state basketball semifinal.

item.title: WATCH: Attack on U.S. service members in Kuwait 'hits close to home'
item.summary: ABC News correspondent and veteran Stephanie Ramos says Kuwait "has always been known as the cush deployment," which is why the attack that killed six U.S. service members "hits close to home."

item.title: WATCH: Burger wars heat up social media
item.summary: Burger King is changing its Whopper for the first time in a decade and McDonald's is bringing the Big Arch to the U.S., but video of McDonald's CEO tasting the sandwich is drawing the most attention.

item.title: WATCH: Senator helps remove protester during Senate hearing
item.summary: Montana Sen. Tim Sheehy was filmed in a confrontation with a protester during a hearing on Capitol Hill Wednesday and assisted officers with his removal.

item.title: Rihanna's Beverly Hills mansion struck by gunfire, woman arrested: Police
item.summary: Rihanna's Beverly Hills mansion was struck by gunfire on Sunday afternoon while she was home, according to the LAPD and sources with knowledge of the investigation.

item.title: WATCH: Children's museum celebrates Princes Tiana
item.summary: A new exhibit at the Children's Museum of Indianapolis called "Tiana's Joyful Celebration" celebrates Disney's first Black princess before traveling to other museums across the country.
